theorem QOU.Archimedean.qSensitivity_eq_logDeriv {q : ℝ} (hq : 1 < q) :
qSensitivity q = q * ((1 - (q ^ 2)⁻¹) * (q - 1 / q) ^ 5 + (q + 1 / q) * (5 * (q - 1 / q) ^ 4 * (1 + (q ^ 2)⁻¹))) / qPrefactor q

theorem QOU.Archimedean.hasDerivAt_qPrefactor {q : ℝ} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
HasDerivAt qPrefactor ((1 - (q ^ 2)⁻¹) * (q - 1 / q) ^ 5 + (q + 1 / q) * (5 * (q - 1 / q) ^ 4 * (1 + (q ^ 2)⁻¹))) q

theorem QOU.Archimedean.hadron_half_life_eq_halfLife (d : BetaDecayData) (r : BetaRateData) (h : r.W2 * r.mu0 / (2 * Real.pi ^ 3) * r.M2 * r.fQ = (d.q - 1 / d.q) ^ 5) :
hadron_half_life d r = d.halfLife

theorem QOU.Archimedean.betaRate_eq_qPrefactor_iff (d : BetaDecayData) (r : BetaRateData) :
betaRate d r = qPrefactor d.q ↔ r.W2 * r.mu0 / (2 * Real.pi ^ 3) * r.M2 * r.fQ = (d.q - 1 / d.q) ^ 5
